brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — lineup unchanged, Higgins/Flowers/Downs Qs all trending toward clearing, Tuten's illness has six days to resolve before Sunday
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE, Yahoo side); Sleeper's first game is Herbert/Hampton Sun 1:25 PM PT vs ARI
Lineup: no changes. Higgins (heel) DNP Tue/Wed but Taylor calls it minor and he's trending toward playing; Flowers (quad) and Downs (calf) are both back at practice and trending clean — no formal downgrades on any of the three. Tuten's illness (not injury) has time to clear before Sunday, but the bigger risk to his workload is Jacksonville's standing 3-way RB rotation with Rodriguez and Allen — don't expect a bell-cow week even if he's cleared. If Higgins, Flowers, or Downs is out: start Diggs. If Tuten is out: start Woody Marks.
Analysis highlights: Hampton is a smash play — ARI allowed the 2nd-most fantasy points to RBs in 2025 and LAC is an 11.5-pt home favorite (28.5 implied), with SoFi's fixed roof taking weather off the table entirely. Chase Brown and Higgins face a Tampa Bay defense that graded out bottom-tier overall in 2025, riding the week's highest total (50.5). Flowers gets the softest individual matchup on the roster — IND allowed the 2nd-most fantasy points to WRs last year.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Isaiah Likely is trending toward NOT playing Week 1 — have Okonkwo ready; still a 39% underdog vs GIBBBBBYYYY, no new screenshots since yesterday
Do now: Likely (recovering from a foot fracture) is still in a no-contact jersey and Harbaugh has made no Week 1 promise — watch Friday's injury report and Sunday's inactives list; if he's ruled out, swap in Chig Okonkwo
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE)
Lineup: one real call this week — Likely to Okonkwo the moment NYG rules him out. Separately, Parker Washington's only injury report on file is about three weeks stale and unconfirmed either way — verify directly against JAX's Wed/Fri report before locking. Judkins draws the toughest matchup on either roster (JAX run defense, only 16.75 implied as a road dog) but there's no better flex on your bench, so he stays in — temper expectations. If Likely is out: start Chig Okonkwo.
Analysis highlights: Etienne's implied total sits at just 21.25 as a 7-point road dog at Detroit, but the intact co-lead role next to Kamara carries him regardless. Garrett Wilson gets a plus matchup on paper at Tennessee but the week's lowest total (39.5, 19.0 implied) caps his ceiling. Pickens and Likely (if he plays) both get the week's best matchup for a pass-catcher — Dallas visits a bottom-5 NYG defense Sunday night.

FYI: Chase Brown and Jason Myers start in both leagues; Michael Wilson sits on both benches. Sleeper opponent AdufortheWin84's TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) hasn't practiced since Aug 24 and looks like a real scratch Wednesday vs SEA — good for your matchup if it holds; his McCaffrey (calf) is back to full practice and expected to play. Yahoo opponent Arshdeep has three shaky Qs: Nabers (ACL, still no clearance), LaPorta (hip, Campbell said "I don't know"), and Jeanty (ankle, expected to play but workload unclear).
